ARCS kitOrganism 49pinned-card

Pinned Details Card

Show the details of the row the reader picked without leaving the full-width grid: a card pinned bottom-right on wide screens, a block below the content on narrow ones.

States

Anatomy

#PartType roleToken (CSS variable)
1LayoutThe grid takes the full width (minmax(0,1fr)); the card is its siblingnone
2Card, wide (961px and up)position:fixed, 16px from the bottom-right, min(25rem, 100vw - 32px) wide, at most 50vh tall, scrolls inside, no scrim; depth from an offset plus soft-blur shadow, no hairlinesurface, ds-r-md
3Card, narrowSits below the content in flow with a hairline border; a Back control instead of the Xsurface, border, ds-r-md
4HeadTitle (focus target), one meta line, optional summary; the 44px X top-rightsurface-2, X text-secondary
5SectionsHairline-split; heading in a 9.5rem left column once the card is 520px wide (container query)border, heading text-secondary

Usage

Use it when

  • A full-width grid or list whose rows each carry a page of detail, and the reader compares rows one after another.
  • Non-modal on purpose: no scrim, rows stay clickable, picking another row swaps the card's content.

Do not use it when

  • Do not use it for a decision the reader must finish first; that is a dialog.
  • Do not draw a hairline border plus a wide shadow on the pinned card; one offset plus soft-blur shadow carries the depth.
  • Do not let it grow past half the window height; it scrolls inside.

Data it reads

FieldTypeRequiredNote
titlestringyesThe picked row's name.
meta[]string[]noKind, day, hours; joined by dots on one line.
sections[]{h, html}yesStatus, What you get, Good to know, and so on; empty sections are left out.
returnToelementyesThe row that opened it; focus goes back there on close.

Access

  • A section labelled by its title (aria-labelledby), with aria-live=polite so a swapped row is announced.
  • Opening moves focus to the title (tabindex=-1); the X (Close details) or Escape closes it and focus returns to the row.
  • Wide: overscroll-behavior:contain keeps a scroll inside the card from moving the page.
  • Slide-in respects prefers-reduced-motion. Rem sizes; at the largest text size the card scrolls rather than clips.
